description: Gemini generateContent with text and an inline PNG, traced by OpenInference.
notes: OpenInference records message content by default, and this scenario sets no content-capture environment variable. The image is a 64x64 PNG generated in the program, stored as a data URL on message_content.image.image.url. Prompt 90 and cache_read 40 are copied; completion 15 is candidatesTokenCount. llm.provider is google and llm.finish_reason is STOP. output.value includes sdk_http_response headers; the mock pins Date so that string stays stable. prices.json has no Gemini model row.
